title: Unwell
subtitle: Midwestern gothic fiction that balances haunted-town dread with found-family warmth.
description: A long-running small-town horror drama about a boarding house, buried history, ghosts, and the people who slowly become each other's family.

length.label: Apple lists five seasons and 129 episodes; the official about page notes 12-episode seasons with biweekly releases.

archiveTake: Stronger for listeners who want gothic atmosphere with affection still left in the tank.

similarReasons.story: Another approachable, character-first entry if you want warmth before the weirdness gets denser.
similarReasons.mabel: A quieter ghost-story branch once the voice-led haunting becomes the main attraction.
similarReasons.desert-skies: Keeps the inviting strange-world quality intact with a little more overt comfort.
